claim: Approval previously covered only Artifact id/version and could be reused after accepted criteria or evidence changed.
evidence: Changing a criterion or Verification after approval did not invalidate approval.
Approval could be written with an open high Finding.
impact: A human could approve one evidence set while final records contained another.
required_action: Bind Approval and ACCEPT to a canonical reviewed-set digest and reject blockers before approval.

prevention.action: Approval and Decision repeat reviewed_set_digest; approve rejects blockers and incomplete execution evidence.
